title: API Starter flow: model picker + request-builder screenshot set
creator: Ava Patel
description: Deliver a cohesive set of production-ready visuals for the Hosted API quickstart flow. Artifacts include annotated screenshots for: model selection (with family grouping and recommended badge), the interactive request builder (temperature, max_tokens, streaming toggle, function/tool calling UI), and three code-snippet tiles (Python, JavaScript, curl) that match the UI state. Images must be export-ready for docs, the console quickstart card, and the marketing quickstarts page.
acceptance_criteria: Six annotated PNG screenshots exported at 2x retina resolution and a matching SVG source for vector elements
Model picker screenshot shows family grouping, recommended model badge, region selector, and a tooltip for performance profile
Request builder screenshot shows filled example prompt, streaming toggle state, function schema dropdown, temperature set to 0.7, max_tokens set to 256, and a visible cost estimate microcopy
Three code snippet tiles (Python, JS, curl) reflect the exact request builder state and copy/paste correctly
Alt text and localization keys provided for every asset
All assets uploaded to the assets repo and linked in the PR; PM and Eng approvals recorded
attachments: figma:Hosted API Starterflow v3 - model picker frames
mockup_notes: Use 14px Inter for body copy, 16px semibold for code tiles heading. Ensure code tabs include copy button and runtime badge (Node/Python). For streaming example, show partial response line with spinner. Add a subtle console-grade border to distinguish product screenshots from marketing images.
story: PM requested a lean visual set for the next docs release to reduce friction for new developers. Design will produce assets that match the console UI so screenshots can be reused across docs and in-console quickstarts. Engineering will provide a staging API key and deterministic sample responses for screenshot consistency.
